Request exactly 1024x1536 pixels: 6 columns by 12 rows, S then SE then E, 66 figures and 6 blank cells. All N-direction rows must show the rear with NO visible eyes or face, including hurt and death poses. NE is a rear three-quarter view facing upper-right, clearly showing the back. SE faces lower-right, visibly distinct from E side profile. HURT must visibly recoil backward. Use only flat solid #FF00FF background; no letters, labels or drawn grid.
